title: Extended Vannila Endgame Addon
description: This is an unofficial addon to the Extended Vanilla Endgame mod that adds support for the Advanced Netherite mod
body:
This is an unofficial addon to the [Extended Vanilla Endgame](https://modrinth.com/mod/extended-vanilla-endgame) project and the [Advanced Netherite](https://modrinth.com/mod/advanced-netherite) project first and foremost, I am not affiliated with them in any way but wanted better support as I think they work well with both.

They work together already however you have to first get tier 10 on a netherite piece and then you can upgrade it. I didn't like that progression so I made the data tags talk to each other and they can go any way. 

This is also a personal preference as I only want diamond netherite supported as that makes sense to me but let me know if you have any ideas.
